paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on Llama3.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy performance of six different methods evaluated across varying co-occurrence numbers. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and employs a logarithmic scale, displaying major tick labels at 0, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$, with data plotted across a range from approximately 3 to 3000. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to slightly above 80, with major tick marks and dashed grid lines positioned at intervals of 5 units (60, 65, 70, 75, and 80). Six solid lines, each representing a different configuration, are shown on the graph. The "Base" line is black with circular markers, demonstrating a steady upward trend from an initial value of approximately 61.2 at x=3 to end at roughly 66.8 at x=3000. The "FT" line is blue with downward-pointing triangle markers, starting at roughly 62.4, rising steadily, and concluding at approximately 68.3 at the end of the x-axis. The "IKE" line is red with upward-pointing triangle markers, steadily increasing from an initial point of around 64.5 to finish at 70.1. The "MEND" line is brown with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 65.8, rising to 71.3 at x=30, and then more gradually increasing to end at 73.9. The "MEMIT" line is purple with hexagonal markers, climbing from an initial value of roughly 66.3 to finish at approximately 72.6 at x=3000. Finally, the "ROME" line is green with square markers; it starts at approximately 72.3, climbs to 75.9 at x=30, and then gradually flattens to end at its peak value of roughly 77.6 at x=3000.
